pairs.title: Swedish krona in euros
pairs.description: How many euros SEK 1 buys. A rising number means a stronger Swedish krona.
pairs.source: Derived from Federal Reserve H.10 series DEXSDUS and DEXUSEU (FRED) on each trading day: € per SEK 1 = (US$ per SEK 1) ÷ (US$ per €1).

pairs.title: Swedish krona in US dollars
pairs.description: How many US dollars SEK 1 buys. A rising number means a stronger Swedish krona.
pairs.source: Federal Reserve H.10 (FRED series DEXSDUS) · noon buying rate, New York; 1 ÷ the published SEK per US$.
